question: The final event in decathlon is always:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1500 m race**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The decathlon is a combined event in athletics consisting of ten track and field events.
 
• The events are held over two consecutive days.
 
• The 1500 meters race is the final event in the decathlon.
 
• Competitors accumulate points in each event, and the overall score determines the winner.
 
• The 1500 meters race is critical as it can significantly impact the final standings due to its high point value.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Decathlon Events:**

 
 
• Day 1: 100 meters, long jump, shot put, high jump, and 400 meters.
 
• Day 2: 110 meters hurdles, discus throw, pole vault, javelin throw, and 1500 meters.
 
 
 
• **Scoring System:**
 
 
• Points are awarded based on performance in each event.
 
• Tables are used to convert performance metrics (time, distance) into points.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context:**
 
 
• The decathlon has been part of the Olympic Games since 1912.
 
• It is traditionally considered the ultimate test of athletic versatility.
 
 
 
• **Notable Athletes:**
 
 
• Jim Thorpe, Daley Thompson, and Ashton Eaton are famous decathletes.
 
• These athletes have set numerous world records and won multiple Olympic medals.
